name: Just Monika.exe
source:
It's that time of the month again pa̵̕p̨̨͝à̡͟?͞ at the Unnamed School.
Everybody is finishing their ĢR̢͟A̸͏҉V͠E҉̧ST́O͠͡Ņ҉E͏̕Ś͟ CAPSTONES, including YOU; our D͟͢R̨O̢͝PD̨̨E̢͠͝A͏͠D͡ No-Name protagonist.

His CAPSTONE requires him to r̶èv̡i̛v͠e҉ visit and interview every club in a week before he graduates.
But there's one club that he hasn't interviewed yet.

THE LITERATURE CLUB.

Your only task is to interview all Four of the Club Members.
And the only way to do that is through the power of T̵O҉R̛̀T̸U͡͝R̴͠E Literature itself.
(Though... something about this concept seems slightly amiss...)

See? It's sounds as easy as di̸e̡̛ pie, right?

.....

B͝Ĺ͠E͢E̡͡D̡I̸͠N̡͠G̨̛̛ ...well...actually... it's NOT.

THERE'S MORE TO THIS GAME THAN WHAT'S ON THE SURFACE.
JUST KEEP DIGGING DEEPER... AND EVENTUALLY, YOU'LL FIND OUT THE TRUTH.

[From [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/JUST-MONIKA/319671]GameJolt[/url]]
translation:
又到了无名学校每个月的这个时候pa̵̕p̨̨͝à̡͟?͞。
每个人都正在完成他们的 ĢR̢͟A̸͏̉V͠Ȩ̉ST́O͠͡Ņ̉E͏̕Ś͟ 顶点，包括你；我们的D͟͢R̨O̢͝PD̨̨E̢͠͝A͏͠D͡无名主角。

他的CAPSTONE要求他在毕业前一周内访问并采访每个俱乐部。
但他还没有采访过一家具乐部。

文学俱乐部。

你唯一的任务是采访所有四位俱乐部成员。
而做到这一点的唯一方法是通过T̵ỎR̛̀T̸U͡͝R̴͠E文学本身的力量。
（虽然……这个概念似乎有点不对劲……）看到了吗？这听起来就像di̸e̡̛ 馅饼一样简单，对吧？

……

B͝Ĺ͠E͢E̡͡D̡I̸͠N̡͠G̨̛̛ …好吧…实际上…不是。

这款游戏的内容远不止表面上的内容。
只要继续深入挖掘……最终，你就会发现真相。

[来自[url=https://gamejolt.com/games/JUST-MONIKA/319671]GameJolt[/url]]
